mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.05 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.5%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate hiring and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where UNRATE < 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production below 102.5 signals manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO < 102.5 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where HOUST rises by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rise and UNRATE decline) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes, a year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
